# Bharat Visa Portal

This is a fictional hackathon prototype. It is not affiliated with the Government of India and never submits real visa applications or payments.

## Main services

- /visa — Regular / Paper Visa
- /evisa — e-Visa
- /afghanistan — Afghanistan Visa (demo entry point)
- /demo — demo application records and connection simulator

## Supported agent actions

START_REGULAR_APPLICATION, START_EVISA_APPLICATION, SAVE_APPLICATION, RESUME_APPLICATION, NEXT_STEP, PREVIOUS_STEP, UPLOAD_DOCUMENT, REVIEW_APPLICATION, SUBMIT_APPLICATION, CHECK_STATUS, SIMULATE_PAYMENT, PRINT_APPLICATION

## Documentation

- /agent.md — canonical product and agent specification
